title: The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie
author: Muriel Spark
summary: An unconventional Edinburgh schoolteacher in the 1930s hand-picks a circle of favoured girls to shape in her own image, until one of them comes to see the cost of her influence.
readIf: you like sharp, short novels about charismatic, flawed teachers and their pupils.
skipIf: you want a warm, sentimental school story.
